notes.title: Dungeon Shooter 2 Steam Release!
notes.notes:
This week we, my brother and I, have achieved a life goal of getting [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/335440#scrollTop=0]Dungeon Shooter 2 on to Steam[/url]! Huzzah!

Now on to what is new and what will be coming.

[b]What's new in the Steam release:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Map Editor[/*]
	[*]Improved User Interface[/*]
	[*]Other minor changes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]What's coming in the next update for sure:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Full Controller Support[/*]
	[*]Help for the map editor[/*]
[/list]
[b]What we are looking into for future updates:[/b]
[list]
	[*]More player models[/*]
	[*]More enemies[/*]
	[*]Workshop Support[/*]
	[*]Localization[/*]
	[*]Achievements[/*]
	[*]Local CO-OP[/*]
[/list]

If have more feature request let us know. 

Thanks for all the support and useful feedback so far.
